android.desc:
Between – Private Couples App is the No.1 space where couples stay connected, keep memories, and build their relationship every day.
Over 35 million couples have chosen Between as their private love tracker, photo storage, and intimate daily connection space.

⸻

All-in-One Relationship Tracker

Your relationship is worth remembering. Between helps you stay connected through a daily feed of chats, shared photos, romantic moments, and special memories.
Count how many days you’ve been together with our love counter and see upcoming anniversaries, birthdays, and milestones.
Between isn’t just a tracker—it’s a reflection of your story.

⸻

Save Photos, Create Memories

All your special photos are safe here. Upload unlimited photos with high-resolution backup and sort them by dates, events, or memories.
Whether it’s a selfie, a holiday, or your first marriage anniversary, Between is your private storage for every moment.

⸻

100% Privacy, Just for Two

Between is a private and secure space. Everything you share—your photos, messages, love counter, and answers to intimate questions—stays between you and your partner.
End-to-end encryption ensures complete privacy and peace of mind.

⸻

Stay Connected, Every Day

Use Between’s real-time chat to talk, send photos, and react to moments instantly.
The app keeps your relationship connected, intimate, and focused—without distractions from ads, groups, or unrelated messages.
You can also share answers to couples questions, laugh over memories, and grow stronger together.

⸻

Track Important Dates

From your first date to your future marriage day, Between remembers it all.
With the love tracker and counter, you’ll never forget important events again.
Set reminders, countdowns, and custom labels to make each moment count.

⸻

Designed for Couples, by Couples

Between was built for couples who want a beautiful, secure, and easy way to manage their relationship.
Whether you’re in a long-distance relationship, newly paired, or years into marriage, Between is your shared space.

⸻

Why Choose Between?
	•	Trusted by over 35M couples worldwide
	•	Highest-rated private couple app
	•	Minimalist, romantic design
	•	No ads, no noise—just you and your person
	•	Exclusive features like love counter, photo timeline, and secure storage
	•	Daily reminders, date countdowns, and mood questions for couples

⸻

For Couples Who Want to:
	•	Track love and relationship milestones

quotes.text:
Sounds like exactly the same thing as the South Korean produced 'Between' app, which is already cross platform. Not to say that they couldn't execute better, but it's not a novel idea.
